newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Southern becomes top brokerage in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: China Southern becomes top brokerage in Shenzhen.

text.p: Shenzhen-based China Southern Securities Co was the southern Chinese city's top brokerage firm in terms of assets and securities turnover in 1996, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Wednesday.
Shenzhen J&A Securities came second on 1996 assets and turnover, the newspaper said. It did not give figures.
China Southern's total assets were valued at 12 billion yuan at end-1996, with net assets of 1.4 billion yuan, a brokerage official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter, China Securities Bulletin.
The official declined to give China Southern's turnover and profit figures.
